subject: geography
sourceName: WJEC Eduqas GCE A Level Geography specification (from 2016)

units.n: 1. Component 1 — Changing Landscapes and Changing Places
subs: Section A: Changing Landscapes (choose one) — Coastal Landscapes OR Glaciated Landscapes

units.n: 2. Component 2 — Global Systems and Global Governance
subs: Section A: Water and Carbon Cycles (compulsory)

Section B: Optional themes (choose two) — Ecosystems; Economic Growth and Challenge; Energy Challenges and Dilemmas; Weather and Climate
Fieldwork-based written investigation (3000–4000 words) drawing on physical and/or human geography
